title: Electrochemical detection of sulfamethoxazole in water matrices using green nanomaterials: pilot-scale validation in a solar photo-Fenton process
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EN00086J, Paper

Víctor Calvo, Constanza J. Venegas, Paulina Sierra-Rosales, Sara Miralles-Cuevas, Alejandro Cabrera-Reina, Wolfgang K. Maser, Ana M. Benito, José Miguel González-Domínguez
This work presents an electrochemical sensor designed as a process-monitoring tool for tracking sulfamethoxazole (SMX) during advanced oxidation processes (AOPs) under pilot-scale, realistic wastewater conditions.
